newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,179 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,179 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,179 contracts compared with 1,134 overnight Monday.
There were 119 wheat, 1,248 corn, 652 soybean, 6 soymeal, 86 soyoil, 26 oat, 24 rice, five soybean calls and 13 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-3/4 to three cents lower, corn was 1-1/4 cents higher to 1-3/4 lower and soybeans were 1-1/2 higher to 3/4 lower.
